2026 General Election

Where to vote on Tuesday,
November 3

Polls open 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM ChST

  • Bring a photo ID. You must show a picture ID to receive a ballot.
  • Can't make it Nov 3? Vote early Sep 18 – Nov 2, 8:30 AM – 4:00 PM daily, including weekends and holidays.
  • Questions? Call the CEC at 235-8683 (VOTE).

Election Day polling places

Not sure which precinct you're in? Look up your registration.

    No polling place matches that search. Try a village name like Garapan or Kagman, or clear the search.

    Early voting sites

    Friday, Sep 18 through Monday, Nov 2. Open 8:30 AM – 4:00 PM ChST every day. Voters from any district who are temporarily on another island can vote early there.

    Polling places designated under 1 CMC §6105(c). Early voting under 1 CMC §6222 and §6224. Photo ID required under 1 CMC §6218.

    P.O. Box 500470
